0.content:
# Home Ops Master Landing v12

Topology-aligned Home Ops index with a live **Architecture Health** strip (infra = 24h; sparse apps = 7d last-seen).

Start with **[Network Overview v3](https://oei3894h.sprint.apps.dynatracelabs.com/ui/apps/dynatrace.dashboards/dashboard/ea910f15-8c41-47dc-a0fc-6c72d7215685#from=now()-24h&to=now())** or the **[Home Ops Launchpad](https://oei3894h.sprint.apps.dynatracelabs.com/ui/apps/dynatrace.launchpads/launchpad/da5398ee-1cea-45e3-b5d7-62e0f5c4b059)**.

**Wave 2:** Ansible · Home Automation Stack · Proxmox · Commander v2 · utility29 HAProxy.

**Still out of DT scope:** elk · pig · LibreNMS. **Backlog:** UPS Telegraf · SNMP traps opt-in after dt02 :162 verify.

**Status:** ✅ works · ⚠️ partial · ❌ broken. **Low-usage:** prefer 7d lookbacks / heartbeat synthetics over traffic silence.

health-apps.query:
fetch user.events, from:now()-7d
| filter in(frontend.name, {"ansible-operations", "Home_Commander__7654", "homeassistant", "www.loadingthekeg.com", "mail.lindleyhome.com"}) or in(dt.rum.application.id, {"e7d68427632a5105", "940d86626ef483d2", "0b844840bbb813cd"})
| summarize events=count(), last=max(timestamp), by:{frontend.name, dt.rum.application.id}
| fieldsAdd app = coalesce(frontend.name, dt.rum.application.id)
| fields app, events, last
| sort events desc
health-apps.title: Sparse apps last-seen (7d RUM)

health-bgw.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "att-bgw320"
| summarize last=max(timestamp)
| fieldsAdd freshness_min = toDouble((toLong(now()) - toLong(last)) / 60000000000)
| fields freshness_min
health-bgw.title: BGW poller freshness (min)

health-md.content:
## Architecture Health

Continuous pipelines (24h) + sparse-app last-seen (7d). Open Problems excludes offline-kiosk noise where detectors were retuned.

health-netflow.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "netflow"
| summarize last=max(timestamp)
| fieldsAdd freshness_min = toDouble((toLong(now()) - toLong(last)) / 60000000000)
| fields freshness_min
health-netflow.title: NetFlow freshness (min)

health-oa.title: OA hosts active (2h)

health-otlp.query:
fetch logs
| filter isNotNull(host.name) and host.name != ""
| filter not matchesPhrase(host.name, "nuc") and not matchesPhrase(host.name, "EasyTravel")
| summarize c=count(), by:{host.name}
| filter c > 10
| summarize otlp_hosts = count()
health-otlp.title: OTLP/Pi log hosts (24h)

health-problems.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" and event.status == "ACTIVE"
| filter not matchesPhrase(event.name, "HA Kiosk")
| filter not matchesPhrase(event.name, "entryway")
| summarize open_problems = count()
health-problems.title: Open problems (excl. kiosk noise names)

health-u29.query:
fetch logs
| filter host.name == "utility29"
| summarize lines = count()
health-u29.title: utility29 log lines (1h)
